meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 它会自动完成 Discord 机器人接入:复制适配器、注册并安装固定版本依赖,构建和测试通过后,引导你创建 Discord 应用、粘贴令牌、重启服务,之后你就能通过机器人私信与 Claude 对话。
howto.when: 当你要添加 Discord 机器人频道,或继续 /setup、/init-first-agent、/manage-channels 流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人接到 NanoClaw 上。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并引导创建应用。

say.text: 这是我的 Discord Bot Token,拿去配置。
邀请机器人到服务器后,测试给我发私信。
say.note: 解析 DM 地址并完成接线。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can automate Discord bot setup: copy the adapter, register it, install a pinned dependency, build and test, guide you through creating a Discord app, store credentials, restart the service, and enable DM chat via the bot.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Discord bot channel, or when continuing /setup, /init-first-agent, or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot to NanoClaw for me.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and guides app creation.

say_en.text: Here is my Discord Bot Token, configure it.
After inviting the bot, test DMing me.
say_en.note: Resolves the DM address and finishes wiring.
